_comment: WP3 network camera sources: MJPEG, RTSP, ESP32-CAM
source.mjpeg.name: Network camera (MJPEG / phone IP camera)
source.mjpeg.desc: Receives an MJPEG image URL, for example from a phone IP-camera app. The computer and the camera must be on the same Wi-Fi.
source.rtsp.name: Network video stream (RTSP)
source.rtsp.desc: Receives an RTSP video URL, for example from an AMB82 board. The computer and the camera must be on the same Wi-Fi.
source.esp32cam.name: ESP32-CAM
source.esp32cam.desc: Connects to an ESP32-CAM running the Arduino CameraWebServer example. The computer must be on the same Wi-Fi (or joined to the ESP32-CAM's own hotspot).
control.net.url.help: The video URL shown by the camera app, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080/video
control.net.rtsp_url.help: Video URL, for example rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/live. You can also enter a video file path to practice.
control.net.transport.help: TCP is more reliable; only try UDP if TCP cannot connect.
control.net.ip.help: Connect the computer to the same Wi-Fi. Find the IP in the Arduino Serial Monitor; when the ESP32-CAM runs its own hotspot it is 192.168.4.1.
control.esp32cam.framesize.help: A larger size gives more detail but is slower. The picture pauses briefly when you change it.
control.esp32cam.quality.help: A smaller number means better quality, but larger files and slower transfer.
control.esp32cam.led_intensity.help: The white LED on the ESP32-CAM board.
control.esp32cam.ae_level.help: With auto exposure on, makes the whole picture brighter or darker.
control.esp32cam.aec_value.help: Only works when auto exposure is off. A larger number is brighter but blurs motion.
control.esp32cam.gainceiling.help: The most the automatic gain may amplify. Higher is brighter but noisier.
control.esp32cam.aec2.help: Another auto-exposure algorithm built into the sensor.
control.esp32cam.bpc.help: Corrects sensor pixels that are always dark.
control.esp32cam.wpc.help: Corrects sensor pixels that are always bright.
control.esp32cam.raw_gma.help: Adjusts the balance between bright and dark areas.
control.esp32cam.lenc.help: Compensates for the lens making the edges darker than the center.
control.esp32cam.dcw.help: Makes the picture smoother when the size is smaller than the sensor's native size.
control.esp32cam.colorbar.help: Shows the sensor's built-in test pattern to check the wiring.
source.net.err.not_open: The camera is not open yet. Press Open first.
source.net.err.auth: {target} needs a username and password, or they are wrong. Enter the ones set in the camera app in the Username and Password boxes.
source.net.err.http: {target} answered with error code {code}. Check that the URL, including the path at the end, is correct.
source.net.err.bad_url: This URL does not look right: {target}. It should start with http://, for example http://192.168.1.20:8080/video.
source.net.err.connect: Cannot reach {target}; no picture for more than {seconds} seconds. Check: is the IP or URL typed correctly, are the computer and the camera on the same Wi-Fi, is the camera powered on and charged? (Details: {detail})
source.net.hint.auth: Check the username and password for typos and capital letters.
source.net.hint.url: The URL is usually shown on the camera app's screen.
source.net.hint.check: Try opening the same URL in a web browser first; come back once you can see the picture.
source.esp32cam.err.not_camera: {target} answered, but it does not look like the ESP32-CAM CameraWebServer program (cannot read /status). Make sure you uploaded the Arduino example ESP32 > Camera > CameraWebServer.
source.esp32cam.err.unreachable: Cannot reach the ESP32-CAM ({target}). Check: is the IP typed correctly (see the Arduino Serial Monitor), is the computer on the same Wi-Fi, is the ESP32-CAM powered? (Details: {detail})
source.esp32cam.hint.sketch: After the ESP32-CAM boots, the Serial Monitor prints: Camera Ready! Use 'http://...' to connect.
source.esp32cam.ctl.unsupported: This camera has no setting called "{key}".
source.esp32cam.ctl.rejected: The camera did not accept {key}={value} (response code {code}).
source.esp32cam.ctl.no_connection: The setting did not reach the camera. Check the connection. ({detail})
source.esp32cam.ctl.unverified: The setting was sent, but the camera's current value could not be read back to confirm it.
source.esp32cam.ctl.mismatch: The camera did not accept {key}={want}; it is still {got}. This sensor may not support it, or a related automatic feature must be turned off first.
source.rtsp.err.bad_url: This URL does not look right: {target}. It should start with rtsp://, for example rtsp://192.168.1.20:554/live.
source.rtsp.err.open: Cannot open the video stream {target}. Check: is the URL typed correctly, are the computer and the camera on the same Wi-Fi, is the camera powered on?
source.rtsp.hint.url: You can also enter a video file path to practice.
source.rtsp.hint.check: Try opening the same URL in VLC or ffplay first to check the stream itself works.
source.esp32cam_demo.name: Simulated ESP32-CAM (no hardware)
source.esp32cam_demo.desc: Simulates an ESP32-CAM running CameraWebServer on this computer, so you can practise the ESP32-CAM controls and behaviour without a board.
